sentences.text: This is the fourth repeat application filed by applicant under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.311/2023 registered at Police Station - Ayodhya Nagar, District - Bhopal (M.P.) for commission of offence under Section 420, 506, 120-B, 467, 468, 471, 191 of IPC and Section 66-D of the Information Technology Act.

entities.text: Police Station - Ayodhya Nagar, District - Bhopal
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Applicant is in detention since 13.05.2024.
His first bail application was dismissed on merit by Co-ordinate Bench of this Court on 19.09.2024 in M.Cr.C. No.38625/2024 and second and third bail applications were dismissed as withdrawn.

2 . As per the prosecution story, complainant Abhijeet Sinha, aged 60 years, a retired employee of BHEL, India, resident of A235 New Minal Residency, Ayodhya Nagar, Bhopal uploaded his resume in a social website NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-JBP:9911 2 MCRC-25953-2025 of Allasiajobs.com.
He received a call from one Arun Gupta from Mobile No.88171876126.
He asked him to join as Factory Manager in Nestle India Limited, Kolkata Branch and asked him to furnish his Adhar Card and salary slip of the last pay withdrawn.
He forwarded the same from his E-mail ID to serviceallasia.jobs.com.

Thereafter, Arun Gupta by sending e-mails and mobile calls made from mobile No.8817187126, 9045055317, Mobile No.8273028116 of Rohan Gupta and Mobile No.
8979147616 of Shriniwasan

for a period from 29.10.2022 to 14.06.2023 on the pretext of registration, activating Job Code, repayment etc. got deposited Rs.1,50,000,00/- (Rupees One Crore Fifty Lac) from him in several account numbers i.e. in Account No.618797089250, IFSC code PYTM0123456, PAYTM Bank Noida, Unitechhimdiaeduconidbi, Account Holder Gautam Kumar Yadav, Account No.0038104000524056 IFSC Code IBKL0000038, IDBI Bank Sikandarpur Gurugram, ALLASIAJOBS, A/C 10127856373 IFSC Code IDFB0041438, IDFC First Bank, Chakan Near Pune.

The aforesaid amount was online transferred by him from his Account Vishal Raj Chourasiya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/33644808/
1 No.10302287420, IFSC code 0000519.

sentences.text: He was cheated, so he made a complaint to Kolkata Police about cheating committed with him.
Complaint was registered in Police Station Gafra, Kolkata (West Bengal) at Crime No.0/2023 for commission of offence under Section 120-B, 420, 506 of IPC.
Later, it was transferred to Ayodhya Nagar Police Station, Bhopal.
In the course of investigation, it was revealed that aforesaid mobile numbers were being used by accused persons.

Debjeet Datta,
Diwakar Mishra and Rishabh Dubey were arrested and their mobiles and laptops were seized.
One Maruti NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-JBP:9911 3 MCRC-25953-2025 Suzuki Grant Vitara car was also seized.
Against them charge sheet has been filed on 07.02.2024.
While investigation is kept open against others.
3. Learned senior counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
Applicant is in jail since 13.05.2024.
It is further submitted that present applicant runs a Kiosk centre in the name of Shri Balaji Enterprises and applicant is the proprietor of the said Kiosk centre.
In this regard, permission was granted to the Spice Money by the Government of India and Reserve Bank of India, for the place Jangal Khirkiya, Police Station Padrona, District Kushinagar (U.P.).
It is further submitted that applicant had no knowledge regarding fraud of money.
When he came to know this fact, then he filed an application under Section 156 of Cr.P.C. before the Court of JMFC Kushinagar on 08.04.2024 and the Court has passed the order.

On that basis, FIR was registered at police station Kotwali Padrona,
District Kushinagar vide Crime No.766/2024 against Aman Kumar Singh, Raghuveer Singh,
Gautam Yadav and others.
There is no criminal record of applicant.
After investigation, charge-sheet has been filed.
Trial of the case will take considerable time.
On the aforesaid pretext, it is prayed that the applicant may be released on bail, pending the trial.

4 . On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant and submitted that the FIR was registered against the applicant at Police Station Ayodhya Nagar, District Bhopal vide Crime No.311/2023 on 05.07.2023.

entities.text: Police Station Ayodhya Nagar, District Bhopal
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Police has seized the documents relating to the present crime from the office of applicant.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-JBP:9911 4 MCRC-25953-2025

Thereafter, in his defence,
present applicant has submitted the false application before the CJM, Kushinagar on 08.04.2024.
It is further submitted that in the FIR registered vide Crime No.766/2024, closure report has been submitted by the police.
It is further submitted that applicant himself provided a bank account to the complainant and the money has directly credited in his account.
The applicant is the main accused.

His first bail application was dismissed on merit by Co-ordinate Bench of this Court on 19.09.2024 in M.Cr.C. No.38625/2024 and second and third bail applications were dismissed as withdrawn when the Co-ordinate Bench was not inclined to grant him bail.
Hence, he prayed for dismissal of this four repeat bail application.

5 . In rebuttal, learned senior counsel for applicant has submitted that closure report submitted regarding Crime No.766/2024 has not been accepted by the Court and the matter is still under investigation.

sentences.text: 6 . I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

7 . Having taken into consideration all the facts & circumstances of the case and the fact that first bail application of applicant was dismissed on merit by Co-ordinate Bench of this Court on 19.09.2024 in M.Cr.C.
No.38625/2024 and his second and third bail applications were dismissed as withdrawn when the Co-ordinate Bench was not inclined to grant him bail and the fact that the money has directly been deposited in the bank account of applicant, but without expressing anything on the merits of the case, I am of the view that it is not a fit case to release the applicant on bail.

8. Consequently, this application under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 for NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2026:MPHC-JBP:9911 5 MCRC-25953-2025 grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant stands dismissed.
9. Learned trial Court is directed to expedite the trial.
Certificate copy as per rules.

(PRAMOD KUMAR AGRAWAL) JUDGE Sateesh Vishal Raj Chourasiya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/33644808/
